# VHDX / VHD Test Data — Provenance

Single repo-root corpus shared by every workspace member (`vhdx-core`,
`vhdx-forensic`, `vhdx-cli`). Integration tests read these fixtures with a
member-relative path (`../tests/data/<file>` from `<member>/tests/`).

Real third-party images (log2timeline/dfvfs) exist to catch parser bugs that
synthetic fixtures built by this library cannot — a doer-checker safeguard where
the fixture builder and the parser would otherwise share the same blind spot.
Synthetic images are generated locally by QEMU with the verbatim commands below.

Fine-grained per-field provenance (block sizes, virtual vs file size, tool
versions, re-download script) lives in [`SOURCES.md`](./SOURCES.md) alongside.
This file is indexed by the fleet catalog at `issen/docs/corpus-catalog.md`.

## Real third-party fixtures (log2timeline/dfvfs — Apache-2.0)

The dfvfs project is Apache-2.0 licensed; its `test_data/` images are
redistributable under that license. Download base URL:
`https://github.com/log2timeline/dfvfs/raw/main/test_data`.

### ext2.vhdx
- **Identity**: native Hyper-V VHDX, ext2 filesystem, 512-byte logical sectors, dynamic. Generated by QEMU v5.2 (per dfvfs).
- **Download**: <https://github.com/log2timeline/dfvfs/raw/main/test_data/ext2.vhdx>
- **Used by**: `core/tests/compat.rs`, `core/tests/corpus_differential.rs`, `forensic/tests/libvhdi_compat.rs`.

### dfvfs_ext2.vhdx
- **Identity**: byte-identical copy of the dfvfs `ext2.vhdx` (same SHA-256), kept under the explicit dfvfs-origin name used by `core/tests/real_images.rs`.
- **Download**: <https://github.com/log2timeline/dfvfs/raw/main/test_data/ext2.vhdx>
- **Used by**: `core/tests/real_images.rs` (`dfvfs_ext2_vhdx_opens_and_has_nonzero_size`).

### fat-parent.vhdx
- **Identity**: FAT filesystem, standalone; serves as the parent disk for `fat-differential.vhdx`.
- **Download**: <https://github.com/log2timeline/dfvfs/raw/main/test_data/fat-parent.vhdx>
- **Used by**: `core/tests/differential.rs`, `core/tests/corpus_differential.rs`.

### fat-differential.vhdx
- **Identity**: differencing VHDX referencing `fat-parent.vhdx` via a ParentLocator. Emits `DifferencingDisk` (Warning) from the analyser (expected).
- **Download**: <https://github.com/log2timeline/dfvfs/raw/main/test_data/fat-differential.vhdx>
- **Used by**: `core/tests/differential.rs`.

### ext2.vhd
- **Identity**: legacy VHD (not VHDX) — used to verify `VhdxReader` rejects non-VHDX containers with an error rather than panicking.
- **Download**: <https://github.com/log2timeline/dfvfs/raw/main/test_data/ext2.vhd>
- **Used by**: `forensic/tests/libvhdi_compat.rs` (`dfvfs_ext2_vhd_is_rejected`).

## Synthetic fixtures (generated locally — QEMU 11.0.0, Homebrew)

No external download. Reproduce verbatim:

### qemu_empty_dynamic.vhdx
```
qemu-img create -f vhdx qemu_empty_dynamic.vhdx 16M
```
Empty dynamic VHDX, 16 MiB virtual size, no data blocks. Base image for the
injection-based detection tests in `forensic/tests/real_images.rs`.

### qemu_fixed.vhdx
```
qemu-img create -f vhdx -o subformat=fixed qemu_fixed.vhdx 8M
```
Fixed-provisioning VHDX, 8 MiB virtual size, all BAT entries FULLY PRESENT — a
structurally different BAT layout from dynamic images. Used by
`core/tests/real_images.rs` and `forensic/tests/real_images.rs`.

### fat.vhdx
- **Class**: SYNTHETIC
- **Tool**: qemu-img 11.0.2 (Homebrew)
- **MD5**: `41a87cf52d33855859070f4e38bd42fa`
- **Round-trip oracle SHA-256** (qemu decoded `fat.vhdx` → `roundtrip.raw`):
  `f350908d5b99b0000f7bd4235ce841db1ee82c809f9fe9a19040257ec1eff4ed`
- **Virtual size**: 8 MiB (8,388,608 bytes)
- **Contents**: FAT16 filesystem with volume label `VHDXTEST`; MBR at sector 0
  (boot signature `0x55 0xAA` at virtual offset 510); FAT16 boot sector at
  offset 512 (`VHDXTEST` label at virtual offset 555 = 0x22B).
- **Used by**: `core/tests/vfs_image_source.rs` — the `open_reader` / `ImageSource` integration tests.
- **Generator commands** (verbatim):
```
hdiutil create -size 8m -fs "MS-DOS FAT16" -volname VHDXTEST /tmp/fat16img
hdiutil convert /tmp/fat16img.dmg -format UDTO -o /tmp/fat16img_raw
qemu-img convert -f raw -O vhdx /tmp/fat16img_raw.cdr /tmp/fat.vhdx       # oracle encoder
qemu-img convert -f vhdx -O raw /tmp/fat.vhdx /tmp/roundtrip.raw          # oracle decoder → ground truth
sha256sum /tmp/roundtrip.raw   # f350908d5b99b0000f7bd4235ce841db1ee82c809f9fe9a19040257ec1eff4ed
```
